title: Slaver
summary: SLAV'ER, noun [the same as slabber.] Saliva driveling from the mouth. SLAV'ER, verb intransitive 1. To suffer the spittle to issue from the mouth. 2. To be besmeared with saliva. SLAV'ER, verb transit

inlines.v: SLAV'ER, noun [the same as slabber.] Saliva driveling from the mouth. SLAV'ER, verb intransitive 1. To suffer the spittle to issue from the mouth. 2. To be besmeared with saliva. SLAV'ER, verb transitive To smear with saliva issuing from the mouth; to defile with drivel.
